summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Backyard Ultra Santo Domingo 2026 race tracking system - Winner Section feature. All backend APIs working correctly. Winner detection logic verified: winner is correctly determined when last active athlete completes MORE laps than all retired athletes. Frontend winner section displays correctly when winner exists and is hidden when no winner.
critical_code_review_comments: Winner logic is correctly implemented: winner_laps > max_retired_laps ensures the last athlete must complete one final lap alone to be declared winner
mark-retired endpoint correctly increments laps_completed before marking as retired (athlete completes the lap before retiring)
Frontend conditionally renders winner section only when stats.winner is not null
seed_data_creation: Database was reset during testing. Current state: 89 active athletes, 1 DNF, current lap 2
context_for_next_testing_agent: Winner detection logic works as follows: 1) Only 1 active athlete remaining, 2) At least 1 retired athlete exists, 3) Active athlete has MORE laps than max retired laps. To test winner scenario: retire all but one athlete, then complete a lap with the last active athlete. The winner section appears on /en-vivo when winner is detected.
